text:
amanda-cs: Heads-up — onboarding with Luminate hit a 429 wall during SDK init. They say it started after a service-account rotate earlier today. Any quick triage pointers?

leo-customer: here's the error they pasted: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 15:04:12 GMT
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 18
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"preflight_rate_limit","detail":"preflight requests exceeded"}```

jared-eng: are they calling preflight/ephemeral token for every single request? that header shape looks like the preflight quota bucket.

leo-customer: yes — their worker model spawns 8 short-lived processes and each process does an init flow that calls the ephemeral token endpoint once per request.

priya-devx: that pattern will burn the preflight quota fast. best practice: reuse ephemeral token per process or share across worker threads, and cache until near expiry. also add exponential jitter on 429s.

jared-eng: quick mitigation: switch to obtaining the ephemeral token once at process start, keep it in-memory, and only refresh when TTL < 20s. sample pseudocode: ```js
// call once at start
const token = await getEphemeralKey()
// reuse for requests
fetch(api, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
// on 401/expired -> refresh with backoff
```

leo-customer: they pushed a change to reuse token per process and still see occasional 429 spikes during deploys/batch starts.

max-sre: we have an adjustable preflight window for new onboardings. I'll open a temporary rate exception for project:luminate for 24h while they complete initial ramp. logging/metrics will be watched.

ops-bot: created incident CS-2026-1148 for quota-exception request by max-sre (status: triaged).

priya-devx: also remind them to upgrade to SDK v0.12.1 — it has a small client-side preflight cache + jitter baked in. share snippet: ```yaml
# client config
preflight:
  cache_ttl_seconds: 45
  jitter: true
```

leo-customer: will do. Jordan (Luminate eng) asks for a 30m walkthrough to verify process and logs — can someone join at 17:00 PST?

amanda-cs: I can join. @jared-eng can you hop on for 20 mins?

jared-eng: yep i can join 17:00 PST. 

leo-customer: patched their init, ran a deploy ramp, 429s dropped to <1/min after token reuse + our temporary quota bump. thanks all :thumbsup:

amanda-cs: great outcome — I'll log this in the account health notes (renewal risk lowered, onboarding blocker cleared). will follow up with a short enablement doc for Jordan.

priya-devx: leaving a short checklist in the thread for future onboardings: 1) token reuse 2) upgrade client 3) backoff+jitter 4) contact CS before ramp >50 concurrency.

amanda-cs: adding checklist to the onboard repo and closing the loop.
